The dotted line that is coming from the top of the picture marks the path that leads from the top of the hill towards the asphalt road, and this is the path that that those who were trapped on these hills were taking indeed the 13th in the morning. At one point they left this little track and walked towards a building which is labelled "White House," but the people referred to a two-storey destroyed house, because the white house must not be confused with the White House in Potocari, so this is wrongly labelled, in fact. And some vehicles can be seen also on the asphalt road. On this picture one cannot say these vehicles were there in order to take the prisoners or if they were part of convoys deporting people towards Kladanj. What can also be seen on this picture is a -- is a group of prisoners assembled on the meadow. We could make a blow-up of this. The area which is circled in yellow is a large group of prisoners sitting on this meadow. This is an instant shot. It doesn't reflect the amount of prisoners that were taken that day. That's an instant shot at a precise hour.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: In addition to the collection point at Sandici meadow, you indicated there was another natural collection point at Konjevic Polje. If we turn back to Prosecution Exhibit 3.3. This picture, taken obviously from the ground, can you give the Court an idea of how the individuals who chose to surrender in this area came down and were assembled?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: So in this area, the -- the people who surrendered were reaching the area where this intersection is, and more towards the south they could -- they could come from whatever direction coming down this hill. But then, depending on the surrender spot, they were taken more towards south, to this football field in Nova Kasaba.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: How far is the football field in Nova Kasaba from this intersection at Konjevic Polje?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Approximately 3 to 4 kilometres.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Turning to Prosecution Exhibit 3.5, there is an aerial image of the football field you referenced as Nova Kasaba. Could you explain when this photograph was taken and what it depicts.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: So this one is also an aerial imagery, dated 13 July, 1400 hours. This shows the football field of Nova Kasaba. The asphalt road is just along this football field. At the bottom right of the picture is the direction towards the intersection of Konjevic Polje, and at the top left the road goes to the entrance of Nova Kasaba. It is just at the entrance of Nova Kasaba. And on this picture, if we make a blow-up of the football field, one can see two groups of prisoners lined in rows. The same situation: This is an instant shot. This picture doesn't say if this is the total amount of prisoners collected that day or if it is only the number of people present at this precise moment.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: So Mr. Ruez, at this point, as of the afternoon of the 13th of July, you have men separated in the White House at Potocari, men separated as the school at Luke, and men collected on fields both in Nova Kasaba and Sandici; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Your Honour, at this time we have a video that we would like to show the Court. It is approximately three and a half hours long. However, it is divided up into chapters and would be conducive to stopping when the Court requires a recess. Mr. Ruez will have the ability to stop the video at certain points in order to educate the Court as to the relevant figures involved and to describe the events in question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. SINATRA
utterances.text: Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. SINATRA
utterances.text: I just wanted to clarify whether this was a videotape made by Mr. Ruez or whether this was a videotape that incorporates the videotape of Zoran Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: I can answer that. I plan to ask Mr. Ruez a few foundational questions about the video and its collection and creation before we play it. I just wanted to get the exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, Prosecution Exhibit number 21, have you had the opportunity to view that videotape?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: And are you aware of how the different pieces of footage were collected during the course of this investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Is, to the best of your knowledge, this videotape a complete compilation of the footage that has been acquired regarding the events from the 11th through approximately the 16th of July, 1995?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes. That's a compilation of all the data we have in office.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Were the different sections of footage or pieces of footage collected from different sources?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: In the video, are the sources or is the source of the footage identified with regard to each particular segment?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Are there or is there a point in the video where there is a blank, where the screen is black?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes. On -- on the pieces of footage that we -- that are originated from Zoran Petrovic, there are still some missing pieces and there would therefore be some -- some blanks which are the same blanks that exist on the original version that we have of this -- of this film.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Were those blanks present on the footage that was actually received by the Office of the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Yes, they were there.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Your Honour, at this time we would like to play Prosecution Exhibit 21.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. SINATRA
utterances.text: Your Honour, I just wanted object to the portions that were videotaped by Zoran Petrovic who was a Studio B Belgrade independent journalist. And the fact that Mr. Ruez himself has already said that it had been tampered with and edited by Mr. Petrovic before it was given to the Prosecution, therefore its authenticity and reliability is a question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I think you should have raised this issue during the Pre-Trial Conference, because at that time we asked both party's comments on that compilation of the video footage. But anyway, let us watch this video first. Then we'll see if your objections has any merits.

utterances.speaker: MS. SINATRA
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Shall we turn off the lights a little bit so that we could have a better view of that video?

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So this is the south of the Srebrenica enclave and it's a build-up of the Serb forces.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Your Honour, I believe we're missing the sound.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ
utterances.text: Vinko Pandurevic, commander of the Zvornik Brigade. The soldier in black is a member of the 10th Detachment. This was Major Jolovic, the commander of the Drina Wolves, Zvornik Brigade. So this is Srebrenica town. It is filmed from an apartment building nearby the Company B in Srebrenica town. So that's not an impact of coming in. It's an outgoing fire from a mortar that is positioned by Bosniak soldiers at -- nearby a gas station. Here the people are boarding UN trucks, driving them towards Potocari. Then the rest of the crowd will follow by foot. This is probably the area of Susnjari where the men start gathering. There is the arrival of the UN base in Potocari of the first refugees coming in. The soldier wearing the blue helmet is a Bosnian Serb soldier, not a -- not a member of a UN. General Krstic, with General Zivanovic. This is at the entrance of Srebrenica town. This is a crew of ten Sabotage Detachment members.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, shall we have a break at this moment?

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. We'll resume at twenty to 1.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. Shall we continue?

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The people here are -- on the right of the picture are Colonel Karremans, at the left General Mladic, the one doing the interpretation is Jankovic, intelligence officer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. DE LA TORRE
utterances.text: Your Honour, the next segment is the second Hotel Fontana meeting, which is a bit longer than we have time for in today's session. So we can either cut it in the middle or save it for tomorrow morning, however the Court would like to proceed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: We'll save it for tomorrow morning. And before the recess, I'd like to remind the parties that during the proceedings if anyone of the parties would like to approach the witness by furnishing him a document or giving him some technical support, I should ask the permission of this Bench and also do it through the ushers so that to avoid any suspicions raised from the other party. On the other hand, witness, although you have been working with the OTP for quite a long year and testified in other cases, I have to remind you that during your stay in The Hague, while you are doing the testimony, you are still under oath, so do not talk to anybody or do not let anybody talk to you about your testimony. Do you understand that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I will not give you the same warning every day, but you have to bear it in mind, especially during the weekend.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I will remember that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We will rise until tomorrow morning, 9.00, in the same courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 16th day of May, 2003, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: Examined by Ms. De la Torre:
--- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.27 p.m.,
